archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Customized with Jewel & Luxury tactile feel for an Ivory 'Luxury Reading Room' aesthetic)

brand_identity.name: Cursive
brand_identity.description: A cognitive wellness and analog creativity platform for adults to restore focus and memory through cursive handwriting.
brand_identity.emotional_goal: A sanctuary for thoughtful people reclaiming focus, memory, creativity, and analog presence through handwriting.
brand_identity.vibe: Cinematic, literary, tactile, emotionally intelligent, slow, calming, premium.

typography.guidelines: Import via expo-font. Never use system default sans-serif for headings. The typographic voice is strictly elegant, literary, and vintage.

colors.guidelines: Avoid any bright, neon, or pure white/black colors. The palette relies strictly on warm ivory paper textures, charcoal inks, and muted gold accents.

spacing.guidelines: Generous whitespace is critical for the 'uncluttered sanctuary' feel. Elements must have room to breathe.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Cinematic, slightly-slower-than-normal (e.g., 400ms-600ms ease-in-out). Fade and gentle slide. Avoid bouncy springs.
motion_and_interactions.haptics: Subtle micro-haptics on successful tracing (impactLight), gentle tactile pulses during screen transitions.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Use ambient motion sparingly. Calm shimmer for loading states. Realistic ink rendering/drawing animations using Skia.

icons.usage: Use icons sparingly. Pair with text where possible. NO emojis.

hero_onboarding.description: Fountain pen resting atop a handwritten journal. Cinematic and tactile. Use for the initial sanctuary onboarding screen.

textures.description: Very old writing paper texture. Use as a subtle multiply/opacity blend background layer for the writing studio.

collections_thumbnails.description: Row of vintage books in a dark academia library. Use for literary or historical collections.
Envelopes with wax seals and a quill pen. Use for 'historical letters' or 'poetry' collections.

archive_thumbnails.description: Close up of an antique book with writing. Use for the Historical Cursive Archive tab.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build strictly as a React Native Expo application using StyleSheet. Do not use Tailwind/className.
Always apply a `data-testid` to interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, list items) formatted in kebab-case based on their role.
Prioritize the 'sanctuary' feeling: use the defined generous whitespace, slow transitions, and strictly adhere to the warm ivory/charcoal palette.
Avoid gamification patterns like bright progress bars or red notification dots. Use subtle gold accents instead.
Ensure the Skia canvas implementation for handwriting rendering feels tactile, avoiding perfectly smoothed digital lines in favor of slight ink bleeding effects if possible.
Do NOT use a standard bottom tab bar with bright active colors; keep it minimal, serif-focused, with a muted gold active state.
Never use generic placeholder images; rely exclusively on the provided media URLs.
